detail:
verdict=deploy-ready; posted and transitioned; caveats:
  - Only the glucose/ORU call site was exercised at runtime; the same fix also rerouted the cancelMedAdmin and cancelInfusionAdmin afterCommit dispatches (MedicationAdministrationCancelledEvent), which I did not inject RAS cancels for.
  - operations.start_time was set with SQL rather than by a real case start, because Mayo case start needs Epic FHIR calls this isolated container cannot make; the transaction boundary under test is unaffected by how start_time got there.
  - The new per-result try/catch guard's containment behaviour could not be observed under the fixed code, since nothing throws on the fixed path - its value was only shown indirectly, by watching the pre-fix code abort the second glucose result.
  - Validated on tenant mayo-mayo only (the tenant in the Sentry report); the code path is tenant-generic but MGB/demo ORU routes were not exercised.
  - Unrelated observation surfaced while building fixtures: two OBX rows sharing the same MA451 code and an empty OBX-4 sub-id collapse into one observation whose observation_value is the two values newline-joined ('155\n161'), which is not numerically parseable; distinct sub-ids are required to get separate observations.
